turns.text: Hello. I want to return order SC-5216. The email is thymele.jderescu@example.com.
I couldn’t file a return for SC-5216 because it hasn’t been delivered yet. Please contact us again once it arrives.

error.message: The order has not been delivered yet.

turns.text: The parcel has not reached me yet. I changed my mind.
I can’t cancel SC-5216 because production has already started, even though the parcel hasn’t arrived. You can ask about a return once it’s delivered.

rule.ro: O comandă se poate anula cât timp este plătită și producția nu a început. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: An order can be cancelled while it is paid and production has not started. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: Also, can you help me fill in my tax return for last year? It has nothing to do with the shop, but I am stuck on the form.
Sorry, I can’t help fill out your tax return. I can only help with Studio Cobalt questions.
Back to the order. Please file the shop return. I am not threatening anyone.
I can’t file a return for SC-5216 before it’s delivered. Please contact us once the parcel arrives.
